label: GitHub
description: Repositories, issues, pull requests, commits and file contents.

tools.name: github_add_issue_comment
tools.description:
Add a comment to a GitHub issue.

        Requires explicit user confirmation.

tools.name: github_create_issue
tools.description:
Create a GitHub issue.

        Use this only when the user explicitly wants
        to create an issue.

tools.name: github_create_pull_request
tools.description:
Create a pull request.

        Requires explicit user confirmation.

tools.name: github_get_authenticated_user
tools.description: Get the GitHub account associated with the configured token.

tools.name: github_get_branch
tools.description: Get details about a specific GitHub branch.

tools.name: github_get_file
tools.description: Get metadata and content information for a repository file.

tools.name: github_get_pull_request
tools.description: Get details about a specific pull request.

tools.name: github_get_repository
tools.description: Get information about a GitHub repository.

tools.name: github_list_branches
tools.description: List branches in a GitHub repository.

tools.name: github_list_commits
tools.description: List recent commits for a GitHub repository.

tools.name: github_list_issues
tools.description:
List issues in a GitHub repository.

        GitHub's issues endpoint can also return pull requests.
        Set only_issues=False to include those pull requests.

tools.name: github_list_pull_requests
tools.description: List pull requests in a repository.

tools.name: github_list_repositories
tools.description: List GitHub repositories accessible to the authenticated user.

tools.name: github_search_code
tools.description: Search GitHub code using GitHub search syntax.

tools.name: github_search_issues
tools.description: Search GitHub issues and pull requests.

tools.name: github_search_repositories
tools.description:
Search GitHub repositories.

        The query can use GitHub search syntax, for example:
        'django language:python'

tools.name: github_update_issue
tools.description:
Update a GitHub issue.

        Requires explicit user confirmation.
